bundle.longDescription: Skidbladnir converts images to WebP while exposing the encoder's full control surface: modes, quality, alpha quality, compression method, segments, spatial noise shaping, filtering, target size and PSNR, multi-pass, partition limit, sharp YUV, low memory, resize and multi-threading.
